thread.title: Bloomberg: T. Rowe Price, JPMorgan cut Apple stakes before stock rallies - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)

author: Liz Kiesche
title: Bloomberg: T. Rowe Price, JPMorgan cut Apple stakes before stock rallies - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)
text:
T. Rowe Price (NASDAQ: TROW ) and JPMorgan Chase (NYSE: JPM ) were among a group of trillion-dollar money managers that sold chunks of Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ) shares in Q1, Bloomberg reports , citing regulatory filings.
TROW sold 35.6M shares, about half its stake in the iPhone maker; its remaining position was valued at about $6.18B at the end of Q1.
JPMorgan divested 8.7M shares, about a sixth of its AAPL stake, while Fidelity Investments sold 21M shares and Wellington Management sold 9.8M shares.
Apple rose 11%, including reinvested dividends, since the end of March, on strong earnings and plans to increase its stock buyback and boost its dividend.
